units.function: Paperclip-specific managed-cloud predicate and optional provisioner stack-context extraction from environment variables.
units.dependencyDirection: Ambient runtime environment becomes a broad managed boolean and Paperclip Cloud metadata consumed by routes and platform floors.
units.keyDataModels: Tenant server token signal, legacy managed-config presence and nullable stack ID/slug/account group/host/cloud origin.
units.lifecycle: Infer managed mode on every call, preserve restrictive legacy/new signal union and expose trimmed optional metadata.
units.testAssessment: The already-completed cloud-instance test unit covers signal union/normalization. Source confirms missing immutable profile and structural metadata validation; it was not reread.
units.designRationale: Migrate cloud detection without accidentally disabling any existing restrictive floor during rollout.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must run managed-cloud and self-hosted/local enterprise from one codebase while keeping identity, data lifecycle and platform ownership explicit and vendor neutral.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY. Preserve the monotonic restriction migration rule, but construct and validate an immutable DeploymentProfile at composition startup; expose capability/ownership ports to application code and keep provider metadata in a cloud adapter.
units.responsibilityConflict: An empty ambient value can alter platform ownership and responsibility semantics without a signed deployment decision, operator identity or audit record.
evidence: existing completed application:server/__tests__/cloud-instance evidence reused without rereading

units.function: Tests for managed-cloud portfolio proxy identity derivation, cache isolation and self-hosted/non-tenant denial.
units.dependencyDirection: Fake actor/runtime environment and injected fetch exercise the real cloud proxy route through Express/Supertest.
units.keyDataModels: Cloud-tenant actor user, stack ID, tenant bearer token, upstream portfolio, per-actor cache and platform errors.
units.lifecycle: Authorize trusted tenant actor, derive headers server-side, fetch/cache portfolio and deny self-hosted or session actors.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 5/5 with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME. Strong spoofing and cache-partition tests exist; origin/SSRF/token, upstream schema/size/error and cache-bound cases are missing.
units.designRationale: Prevent clients from selecting another cloud identity or forwarding their own bearer token through the tenant proxy.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS managed adapters must bind upstream calls to verified human identity and tenant context without accepting client-controlled delegation headers.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the server-derived identity and per-principal cache isolation tests for every cloud/enterprise adapter. Add validated destinations, bounded typed responses, token rotation, failure/circuit and tenant-stack isolation cases.
units.responsibilityConflict: The tests prove identity routing but not whether the human may view/switch the returned companies or how that cross-stack action is audited and attributed.
evidence: 2026-08-18 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME: 5/5 passed

units.function: Tests that managed-cloud tenants cannot create a second company while self-hosted local setup can create its first company/owner membership.
units.dependencyDirection: Ambient cloud signal and fake actor drive the real companies route with mocked company/access/budget/activity services.
units.keyDataModels: Cloud/local board actor, managed floor code, company creation, default responsible user and owner membership.
units.lifecycle: Apply platform floor before validation/mutation or create the local company and ownership relationship.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 3/3. It omits legacy managed-config, actor variants, count/concurrency, other company lifecycle paths, idempotency and responsibility/audit evidence.
units.designRationale: Keep cloud tenant/company lifecycle platform-owned while preserving independent self-hosted onboarding.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS requires explicit canonical ownership for organization lifecycle in each deployment profile without forking business code.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the fail-before-validation/mutation floor and cross-profile tests. Replace ambient detection with immutable profile capabilities and require verified human identity/organization contract before assigning responsible ownership.
units.responsibilityConflict: Self-hosted local_implicit identity is directly made default responsible owner; a local technical session is not necessarily a verified accountable human.
evidence: 2026-08-18 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME: 3/3 passed

units.function: Paperclip Cloud portfolio reverse proxy with trusted actor headers, server token and a short in-memory per-user cache.
units.dependencyDirection: Paperclip Cloud environment/actor becomes an authenticated request to a vendor control-plane URL; opaque upstream JSON is returned and cached.
units.keyDataModels: CloudStackContext, cloud_tenant actor, tenant bearer token, stack/user headers, opaque portfolio and cache entry.
units.lifecycle: Validate broad context/actor, clean expired cache, build URL, fetch with timeout, map errors, cache and return upstream payload.
units.testAssessment: Focused route tests pass, but destination trust, response contracts, cache bounds and resiliency are important untested source-level gaps.
units.designRationale: Expose a user's Cloud stack portfolio without letting browser credentials or spoofed identity cross the server boundary.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS Web may consume managed-cloud organization portfolios or enterprise directories through stable provider adapters.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY because the route/DTO/headers are Paperclip-specific. Implement a typed OrganizationDirectoryPort adapter with startup-validated HTTPS allowlist, egress firewall, secret audience, bounded schema, cache cap, circuit breaker and provenance.
units.responsibilityConflict: The proxy proves actor identity transport but has no explicit authorization decision, responsibility scope or evidence for portfolio access and later stack switching.
